items.description: Section 4 claims every in-repo call site of DataArray.integrate except one passes the coordinate positionally, and enumerates them. The enumeration omits ds["var"].integrate("y") at xarray/tests/test_dataset.py:6597, structurally identical to the listed :6583. The universal it supports still holds - the omitted call is positional too - so this is a defective evidence list, not a false premise.
